segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמּוּדָּר הֲנָאָה מֵחֲבֵירוֹ וְנִכְנַס לְבַקְּרוֹ — עוֹמֵד אֲבָל לֹא יוֹשֵׁב. וּמְרַפְּאוֹ רְפוּאַת נֶפֶשׁ, אֲבָל לֹא רְפוּאַת מָמוֹן.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one for whom benefit from another is forbidden by vow and he enters» his house «to visit him, he stands» there «but does not sit. And» that other person «heals him» with «a cure» of the «nefesh but not a cure of mamon.»

moves.summary: rules the visitor stands but does not sit, and may effect a cure of the body but not of property

positions.claim: the visitor stands but does not sit, and may heal with a cure of the body but not of property
